review_provenance.name: an AI assistant, automated visual inspection
review_provenance.method: Inspected numbered contact sheets of every flagged candidate (reports/label_review/<id>/flagged_sheet_*.png, detail_sheet.png with split proposals and neighbouring candidates) and all native-resolution ROI tiles (reports/label_review/<id>/roi_tiles/) with strokes overlaid. No model predictions existed at review time.

notes.convention: Inferred annotation convention, applied consistently: one outline per barnacle around the opercular opening/plates; empty shells (hollow dark interior, no plates) are NOT outlined in either image. This is an observation about the supplied labels, not an ecological live/dead classification.
ambiguous_cases_for_human_review: img1_c000898 (multi_ring, 14x12 px at x1189-1203, y1183-1195): kept as one small target; the second interior may be a crossing stroke.
img1_c001687 (multi_ring, x1976-2011, y1836-1855): split into a small and a larger opening; could be one target.
img1_c000707 (open_contour, 6x15 px at x1634-1640, y1000-1015): thin mark in a shadowed crevice; kept because the supplied annotation marks it, target not visually confirmable.
Seaweed-covered area approx. x1450-1700, y1130-1400: barnacles hidden under algae are unlabeled and also invisible; visible ones are outlined.
Empty shells (e.g. near x1788,y1258; x1938,y1218; x2363,y1278) are unlabeled by convention; whether scientists want them counted needs a human decision.
Targets partly under the frame wire along the ROI boundary are outlined only where visible.
notes.unflagged_candidates: Unflagged single-ring candidates were reviewed only as part of the ROI tile survey, not one by one.
